text: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。法新社记者提问，据报道，中国已告知日本软银集团（SoftBank），不会批准其收购瑞士-瑞典合资企业ABB旗下的机器人业务。报道称，软银近期获悉该交易将被中国国家发展和改革委员会阻挠。外交部能否确认相关消息？ “这个问题建议向中方主管部门进行询问。”郭嘉昆说。（澎湃）
text_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun hosted a regular press conference. An AFP reporter asked that, according to reports, China has told Japan's SoftBank Group that it will not approve its acquisition of the robotics business under Switzerland-Sweden joint venture ABB. The report said SoftBank recently learned that the deal would be blocked by China's National Development and Reform Commission. Can the Foreign Ministry confirm the relevant information? "I suggest you ask the competent Chinese authorities about this question," Guo Jiakun said. (The Paper)
